name: Brite Wholesale Electric Supply, Inc.
old_description: has served Hardin County and the surrounding communities since 1984.
about:
Founded in 1984, Brite Wholesale Electric Supply, Inc. is headquartered in Shepherdsville, Kentucky. The business began serving Hardin County and has since expanded to six locations throughout the state.

As an independent electrical distributor, the company stocks supplies and materials for residential, commercial, and industrial electrical jobs and maintenance. Its six branches enable free local delivery across many Kentucky communities.

Customers include electrical contractors, maintenance teams, and facility managers across residential construction, commercial building, and industrial plant sectors. The company supplies wire, conduit, lighting, and related electrical products.

Brite Wholesale differentiates itself through a service-focused culture and its Owner-Member status in AD, a national buying group of independent distributors. That affiliation provides shared expertise and purchasing leverage, which the company says helps it compete effectively and stay ahead of industry trends.
